title: DiT
core_mech: 把 noisy latent patch 化，以 adaLN-Zero 条件化的 Transformer blocks 作为 diffusion score/velocity backbone。
core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional U-Net backbone in Latent Diffusion with an isotropic Vision Transformer over latent patches conditioned via Adaptive LayerNorm-Zero (adaLN-Zero).
input_desc: 加噪 latent 图像 z_t、时间 t 与可选类别/条件 c
input_en: Noisy latent tensor z_t, diffusion timestep t, and conditioning embedding c
output_desc: epsilon/score 参数与可选方差预测，经逆扩散得到并解码的图像
output_en: Predicted noise ε_θ, diagonal covariance Σ_θ, or velocity v_θ on the latent token grid

source.title: DiT

adapter.name: DiT
adapter.mechanism: Original patch Transformer, time/class embeddings and adaLN-Zero backbone, trained with epsilon prediction.
limitations: Two Transformer blocks on small image pixels; no pretrained latent VAE. Original code is CC BY-NC 4.0, not MIT.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
